Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale (mainland China) spatial optimization of urban land and cropland—a subset of land use/land cover (LULC)—using the LANDSCAPE cellular automata model to simulate future LULC distributions for 2030. It implements four distinct scenarios (including BAU and three optimization scenarios) and quantitatively compares their outcomes in terms of ecological land loss, agricultural production capacity (APC), and spatial allocation. The study reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Kappa Simulation scores >0 for all land classes, with cropland = 0.248 and urban = 0.534), uses spatially explicit modeling at 1 km resolution, and produces mapped projections of occupied and compensated cropland under each scenario. All core inclusion criteria are met: national scale, primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy validation, and mapped LULC outputs. It does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
